# openwebui_pipeline (Resource)

Registers a pipeline with Open WebUI. Pipelines run on a separate server; provide either `url` to load from a running server or `source_path` to upload a pipeline file.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "openwebui_pipeline" "example" {
  url = "http://pipelines.internal:9099"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `source_path` (String) Local path to a pipeline `.py` file to upload.
- `url` (String) Base URL of the pipeline server to register, e.g. `http://pipelines.internal:9099`.
- `url_idx` (Number) Index of the pipeline server URL as stored by Open WebUI. Defaults to 0.

### Read-Only

- `details_json` (String) JSON metadata about the pipeline as returned by Open WebUI.
- `id` (String) Composite identifier in the form `pipeline_id:url_idx`.
- `pipeline_id` (String) Pipeline identifier assigned by the pipeline server. Set by Open WebUI.
